text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few months after the fiercely contested Mile Championship—

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: And now, we shall proceed to the next award.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
"Best Junior Umamusume," Fuji Kiseki-san!
"Best Classic Queen Umamusume,"
Hishi Amazon-san! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Congratulations~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
North Flight was attending the URA Awards ceremony,
honoring the Umamusume who achieved outstanding results that year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The reason, of course, being—

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
And now, let us announce our next award winner.
North Flight-san, please come to the stage!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...Well then, Trainer.
I'm counting on you for that matter!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As for that favor North Flight asked of me—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hello, Trainer-san!!
choice_data_list: Hello there, keep your voice down a little, okay?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hello there,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
And so, what did you need me for?
It looks like the party is still going on, though...?
choice_data_list: Just hold on a little bit longer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh!
Looks like Flight-san is going to speak!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: In honor of North Flight-san's wonderful achievements――

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
It's a double win for both
"Best Senior Queen Umamusume"
and "Best Sprint Umamusume"!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
I am truly honored.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"However...
Please let me share one important thing with you!"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin O-chan!
Could you come up to the podium?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
?
Yes, sirrr!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes!
What is it, a speech?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
That's right.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: May I go first?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Here you go~!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
As you all know,
Bakushin O-chan and I have been competing against each other in the sprint division.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin O-chan at 1200m.
And me at 1600m...
We each showed our brilliance to the absolute fullest.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
An "individuality" tailored from first-rate materials
is truly haute couture.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Comparing two such things and judging them...
Don't you think that's just... kind of nonsensical?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Because! Both of our coordinates
were absolutely fabulous, weren't they?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Whether unable to grasp the true meaning behind the question or simply taken aback... the venue falls silent.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
North Flight waits earnestly for a response.
With her confidence, she probably doesn't feel uneasy.
Even so, as her Trainer...—

text_block_list.name: Staff Member A
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed... It took quite a long time
to choose the 'Best Sprinter,' after all."

text_block_list.name: Staff Member B
text_block_list.text:
Both of them showed off such incredible speed!
There's no doubt that both were at their absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap clap clap...!)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Everyone... thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
It is precisely because of her presence that my individuality
shines all the brighter.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
So, I want to receive this 'Best Sprinter Umamusume' award...
together with Bakushin O-chan, the two of us.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: What a surprise!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
To everyone involved, would you please
indulge this selfish request of mine?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ahem!
Of course it's good, no question about it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Flight-san and me! Both of us are
top-grade, exemplary... stylish Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Come on, everyone! A warm round of applause!
Please, put your hands together for us!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap, clap, clap!!)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yay♪
Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Flight-san!
Looks like they want a photo!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Let's strike a stylish pose!
Sha-bam!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Oho, so that's how Bakushin O-chan
interprets being fashionable.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Awesome~♪
Fufu... You really are wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Nahaha~, really?
Flight-san is truly an amazing person!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The venue is enveloped in warm applause. A grand, resounding applause
symbolizing that both of them
are magnificent sprint Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Sakura Bakushin O and North Flight. Perhaps the battle between these two... might just change the future someday—
